section: full branch diff after PID follow-up

review.finding: Initial review found that GetExitCodeProcess could misclassify a terminated process whose valid exit code is STILL_ACTIVE (259). Resolved before re-review by using SYNCHRONIZE plus WaitForSingleObject(handle, 0), where only WAIT_TIMEOUT means alive.
review.suggestion: Resolved; the final reviewer confirmed GetExitCodeProcess is never invoked and every opened handle is closed.

review.finding: Initial review found that the no-signal dispatch test did not exercise Win32 wait states, API failures, access denial, or handle closure. Resolved before re-review with portable fake-kernel32 tests covering each state and DWORD-range rejection.
review.suggestion: Resolved; the final reviewer confirmed the portable tests and the real Windows current-PID smoke test cover the required behavior.

disposition: Stage 2 PASS on re-review; no remaining correctness, security, ctypes-signature, race-handling, test-hygiene, or ADR-045 finding.
